description: Add a column to a table, or change one when columnId is given. A relation column links to the rows of another table or view.

columnId.description: Column to change, instead of tableId

mandatory.description: Rows must have a value (default false)

labelColumn.description: Column of the target that names a row, by title or ID

targetId.description: ID of that table or view

settings.description: Other Tables column parameters, e.g. numberMin, textMaxLength

subtype.description: Variant: text 'line', 'long', 'rich' or 'link'; number 'stars' or 'progress'; datetime 'date' or 'time'; selection 'multi' or 'check'

tableId.description: Table to add the column to

name: save_table_column
title: Save Table Column
